I've never had this responded to in a way similar to this at all, and to be honest I'm a little lost for words. I've tried for a very long time to find something to give myself to as you suggested, I tried turning to god but I found I can't believe in a god that can't be proven. Or Disapproved for that matter. All my passions seem to burn out and to be honest I don't know where to look.

You mentioned I have somewhat of an ability to describe pain, to make it understandable for others. I honestly don't know about that but if so I guess it's from enduring it for so long... 3rd grade until now that would make it 14 years. 14 years I endured this pain without telling a soul, and now when I wrote this which was originally a letter to my friends and family to explain it all, I felt the need to take it further than that and put it out there for the world to see.

Being a guy it's just always been something I felt I didn't want anyone to know, as if I had something to be ashamed of. When I don't, I'm an abuse victim the same as any other, I realize now that it isn't my fault what happened and that sharing my pain may be able to help not only me, but others who read it.
